bio.short: TWON is a San Francisco open format DJ rooted in hip hop and R&B, sliding into house and tech house when the night calls for it. Vibes curator, festival lover, and the guy digging up the songs ya had to be there for.
long: TWON is a San Francisco based open format DJ who builds his sets on hip hop and R&B. Throwbacks, West Coast bounce, and the records that defined a moment sit right next to today's hits, so every crowd hears something they love and something they forgot they loved.
When the energy climbs, he takes the room into house and tech house without losing the groove. A festival lover at heart, TWON reads the floor first and plays for the vibe, not the playlist.
His DEEP CUTZ mix series digs into the catalogs of artists who shaped a scene, starting with YG: quick cuts of the songs ya had to be there for. TODO: add where you play, residencies, or what's next.
